cover.title: Hanuman Chalisa
cover.subtitle: A picture book of Hanuman's story

verses.doha-1: We bow to our teacher's feet. That clears our hearts like a clean mirror, so we can sing Rama's good name.
verses.doha-2: We may feel small, so we think of Hanuman. Please give us strength, smart thinking and learning, and take our troubles away.
verses.chaupai-1: Hooray for Hanuman, an ocean of good things to know! His light shines across all three worlds.
verses.chaupai-2: Hanuman carries messages for Rama and is super strong. He is Mother Anjani's son and the Wind's child.
verses.chaupai-3: Hanuman is brave and mighty as thunder. He chases away silly thoughts and stays close to kind ones.
verses.chaupai-4: Hanuman's skin glows like gold and he dresses beautifully. He wears earrings and has curly hair.
verses.chaupai-5: He holds a thunderbolt and a flag. A sacred thread of grass sits on his shoulder.
verses.chaupai-6: He comes from Lord Shiva and is Kesari's dear son. The whole world loves his shining strength.
verses.chaupai-7: Hanuman is wise, good and clever. He is always ready to help Rama.
verses.chaupai-8: Hanuman loves listening to Rama's stories. Rama, Lakshmana and Sita live in his heart.
verses.chaupai-9: He became tiny to meet Sita, then grew giant and set Lanka glowing with fire.
verses.chaupai-10: He became huge to stop the bad demons. He finished every job for Rama.
verses.chaupai-11: He brought the magic herb that woke Lakshmana up. Rama was so happy that he hugged Hanuman.
verses.chaupai-12: Rama praised Hanuman a lot. He said, "You are as dear to me as my brother Bharata."
verses.chaupai-13: "A thousand voices sing your praise," Rama said, and hugged him close.
verses.chaupai-14: Great sages, Lord Brahma, Narada, Saraswati and the king of snakes all sing about him.
verses.chaupai-15: Even the gods who guard the world cannot tell all of his greatness. Poets cannot either!
verses.chaupai-16: Hanuman helped Sugriva by bringing him to Rama, and Sugriva became king again.
verses.chaupai-17: Vibhishana listened to Hanuman's advice and became the king of Lanka.
verses.chaupai-18: The sun is very, very far away, but baby Hanuman jumped up to it because he thought it was a sweet fruit!
verses.chaupai-19: With Rama's ring in his mouth, he leapt across the whole ocean. No wonder, for Hanuman!
verses.chaupai-20: Hard jobs become easy when Hanuman helps you.
verses.chaupai-21: Hanuman guards Rama's door. Nobody goes in without his say.
verses.chaupai-22: Everyone who comes to Hanuman finds joy. When he protects you, there is nothing to fear.
verses.chaupai-23: Only Hanuman can hold his own great power. When he roars, all three worlds shake.
verses.chaupai-24: Scary ghosts stay far away when you say brave Hanuman's name.
verses.chaupai-25: When we keep saying Hanuman's name, sickness and pain go away.
verses.chaupai-26: Hanuman saves us from trouble when we think of him with our heart, words and actions.
verses.chaupai-27: Rama is the king of all, and Hanuman helped with all of his work.
verses.chaupai-28: If you wish for something good, Hanuman helps your life bloom.
verses.chaupai-29: Hanuman's glory shines in every age. It lights up the whole world.
verses.chaupai-30: Hanuman protects good and gentle people. He beats demons and Rama loves him.
verses.chaupai-31: Mother Sita blessed Hanuman so he could give special gifts and treasures.
verses.chaupai-32: Hanuman holds the sweet medicine of Rama's love. He is always Rama's helper.
verses.chaupai-33: Singing to Hanuman brings us to Rama, and old sadness melts away.
verses.chaupai-34: At the end, we go to Rama's home and are known as his friends forever.
verses.chaupai-35: You don't need anything else. Hanuman brings every kind of happiness.
verses.chaupai-36: Troubles end and pain goes away for anyone who remembers mighty Hanuman.
verses.chaupai-37: Hooray, hooray, hooray for Hanuman! Please be kind to us like a loving teacher.
verses.chaupai-38: Whoever sings this a hundred times becomes free and very happy.
verses.chaupai-39: Whoever reads this Hanuman Chalisa does well. Lord Shiva himself is the witness.
verses.chaupai-40: Tulsidas is always God's helper. He asks, "Please come and live in my heart."
verses.doha-close: Hanuman, son of the Wind, takes away troubles and brings good luck. Please live in our hearts with Rama, Lakshmana and Sita.
